title: VDBE P4 ephemeral-function, Mem, and function-context leaf release

scope.rationale: These three source helpers are the leaf destructors used by freeP4 for P4_FUNCDEF, P4_MEM, and P4_FUNCCTX. Their owned fields and SQLITE_FUNC_EPHEM flag completely determine whether nested allocations and functions are consumed.
excluded_responsibilities: General Mem release semantics outside P4_MEM

external_source_responsibilities: Callers provide exact P4-owned FuncDef/Mem/Context allocations
dependencies.caller_closure: All active leaf destructor functions and discriminating fields/flag are assigned. Top-level P4 dispatch and remaining composite owner families remain follow-on units.

inputs: connection owner and live FuncDef, P4 Mem, or function Context with a live pFunc
ephemeral bit, Mem szMalloc/zMalloc, or Context pFunc
outputs: conditional ephemeral FuncDef free; nested Mem allocation plus Mem free; nested ephemeral function plus Context free
contracts.ownership: Non-ephemeral FuncDef remains externally owned. Ephemeral FuncDef is consumed. P4_MEM always consumes Mem and consumes zMalloc exactly when szMalloc is nonzero. P4_FUNCCTX consumes its ephemeral pFunc when applicable and always consumes Context.
contracts.state_and_results: No return value; free-list ownership transitions are final. FuncDef and Context.pFunc are required live owners, matching the source dereference contract.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. No callback or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No allocation or OOM. Inputs must be live allocations of the expected P4 type; final owners become inaccessible.

representation_differences: SQLITE_FUNC_EPHEM is an exact u32 Zig constant used against FuncDef.funcFlags.
C char*/void* free casts become exact aligned opaque-pointer casts into the same connection allocator.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker allocates required live static and ephemeral FuncDef owners, Context values with both static and ephemeral pFunc, and P4 Mem values both with and without owned zMalloc. C and Zig invoke each leaf helper and compare lookaside free-list membership for every consumed and retained owner in a 363-observation trace.
internal_observations: Context is always returned; its FuncDef is returned only when ephemeral
Mem is always returned; zMalloc is returned exactly when szMalloc is nonzero
oracle.normalization: Addresses normalize to membership in the owning connection free lists. Type flags and consumed-owner booleans are exact.

assurance.oom: No allocation. Every assigned nested and outer owner is observed returned exactly once.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback; caller mutex remains integration obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Source assumes valid P4 type/object pair; helper tests use exact layouts and live allocations.
assurance.continuation: Static function remains usable until test cleanup; consumed owners are removed from worker tracking.
assurance.performance: Constant-time flag checks and at most two connection frees preserve source shape.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact FuncDef/Context/Mem/Sqlite3 owners. Top-level freeP4 is not yet connected.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Complete remaining P4 families and dispatch first.

independent_review.notes: Requires top-level P4/destruction integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Port remaining P4 owner families and top-level freeP4 dispatch.
Integrate P4 replacement, operation-array destruction, and VDBE deletion.
